entities.summary: The Treaty of Polyanovka, also known as the Peace of Polyanovka was a peace treaty signed on 14 June 1634 between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia in the village of Semlyovo located near the Polyanovka river between Vyazma and Dorogobuzh.
